experiment.claim: README.md 'Target specification (ratified -- see DR-005, issue #1)' row 'Iq' (< 50 uA), for the 3.3 V primary flavor (DR-001). Measures the total current out of the single supply source feeding the ROUTED bandgap-core layout (issue #62, thick-oxide geometry per issue #620; its LVS verdict is cited under 'Netlist provenance', not asserted here) -- both core branches, the R2A/R2B legs and the error amplifier's mirrored tail, now including the drawn VDD/VSS routing's own series resistance -- open-circuit at VREF, over the full 45-point PVT matrix, via klt extract --parasitics translated to a simulatable netlist (sim/bin/post_layout_common.py) -- NOT design/bandgap_core.sch directly; see 'Netlist provenance' below.

spread_checks.note: Iq must move by at least 1 uA across the 45-point matrix. A dead-flat current would mean the corner/temperature/supply knobs are not reaching the simulator -- the same liveness argument sim/pdk-smoke/ makes for the harness itself.
